'''February 2001 Madrid tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Avalon Comics, Madrid, Spain on 24 February 2001. [[Miguel Tarin Vegas]] won it. It is known from Angel San Jose's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1776">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-24-ithor-madrid-spain-feb-24-2001d1776/ ithor-madrid-spain-feb-24-2001], DeckTech (Angel "Dj" San Jose, 24 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-24-ithor-madrid-spain-feb-24-2001d1776/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Avalon Comics, Madrid, Spain
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 11
* '''Winner:''' [[Miguel Tarin Vegas]]
